If sentiment is positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to capture bullish momentum.

If sentiment is negative (≤-0.33) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to offset bearish pressure.

If sentiment is neutral (0.00–0.33) and forecast is trending upward, add 0.5–1.0% to mid-horizon (8–15 days) to compensate for lagging sentiment signals.

If sentiment is neutral and forecast is trending downward, subtract 0.5–1.0% from mid-horizon (8–15 days) to avoid overcorrection.

In late horizon (16–30 days), if sentiment turns positive after 10 days, add 0.3–0.8% to forecast to capture sentiment reversal.

In late horizon (16–30 days), if sentiment remains negative after 10 days, subtract 0.3–0.8% to avoid prolonged bearish bias.
